files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Cut the birth_year column of riders.csv, taken in file order, into consecutive blocks of four values (rows 1-4, rows 5-8, and so on) and add up each block; an empty birth_year is left out of its block's sum. `result` should hold one sum per block (100 sums), in block order.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; birth_year in file order cut into 100 consecutive blocks of 4 rows; sum of the non-empty values of each block; 100 sums in block order.

acceptable_variants.notes: result may be a Series, list or one-column table; sums may be float; a block whose four birth_year values are all empty may hold 0 or an empty value

intent_summary: Sum a column of whole numbers in consecutive, non-overlapping blocks of four values, one sum per block, the last block included.
